create_Lfm2ForCausalLM: create an Lfm2ForCausalLM model with vLLM config for causal language modeling
build_Lfm2Model: build an Lfm2Model with vLLM config that supports attention and short convolution decoder layers
run_Lfm2Model_forward: run the Lfm2Model forward pass with input ids, positions, and optional intermediate tensors
load_Lfm2ForCausalLM_weights: load pretrained weights into an Lfm2ForCausalLM model with automatic weight mapping and parallel loading
compute_Lfm2_logits: compute logits from hidden states using the Lfm2ForCausalLM logits processor and LM head
